response.rationale: The most recent excised vulvar mass was histologically diagnosed as chondroid syringoma, and the new recurrence near the fourchette is most plausibly the same tumor. Clear cell hidradenoma was a prior diagnosis but not the most recent pathology.

rejected.why: Clear cell hidradenoma was documented only in an earlier recurrence; the latest excision and the clinical pattern favor recurrent chondroid syringoma.
